description: This file defines an abstract class 'WorkflowCanvas' that manages the rendering and interaction logic for a workflow diagram, including connection setup, activity element handling, and dynamic canvas height adjustment.

classes.name: WorkflowCanvas
classes.description: An abstract class for managing workflow diagram rendering and interactions.

methods.name: getActivityElements
methods.description: Returns jQuery collection of activity elements within the container.

methods.name: getDefaults
methods.description: Provides default configuration for jsPlumb connections.

methods.name: createJsPlumbInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new jsPlumb instance configured for the container.

methods.name: getEndpointColor
methods.description: Determines endpoint color based on activity properties.

methods.name: getSourceEndpointOptions
methods.description: Generates options for source endpoints based on activity and outcome.

methods.name: getActivity
methods.description: Retrieves an activity by ID from the workflow type.

methods.name: updateConnections
methods.description: Establishes connections between activities based on workflow transitions.

methods.name: updateCanvasHeight
methods.description: Adjusts the canvas height dynamically based on activity positions.
